questions.question: Describe the difference between intrusive and extrusive igneous rocks. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Difference between intrusive and extrusive igneous rocks. (8 marks)
  • • Intrusive (Plutonic) Rocks: 4 marks
  • o Form beneath the Earth’s surface.
  • o Slow cooling → large, coarse-grained crystals (e.g., granite).
  • o High visibility mineral grains.
  • • Extrusive (Volcanic) Rocks: 4 marks
  • o Form on or above the surface.
  • o Rapid cooling → fine-grained or glassy texture (e.g., basalt).
  • o May contain vesicles due to trapped gas.

questions.question: Discuss the process of fossilisation. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:

  • • Definition of fossilisation. 2marks
  • • Conditions favorable for fossilisation: rapid burial, low oxygen, fine sediments-2marks
  • • Processes: 4 marks
  • o Permineralisation: minerals fill pores.
  • o Carbonisation: organic material leaves a carbon film.
  • o Replacement: original material replaced molecule by molecule.
  • o Recrystallisation: minerals reorganize into more stable forms.
  • o Moulds and casts: impressions left in sediment.
  • o Amber preservation: organisms trapped in tree resin.
  • o Freezing and desiccation.
  • • Importance of fossilisation for geological history and evolution- 4 marks

questions.question: Discuss the size, shape, volume and density of the Earth. Explain how rotation and revolution influences weather and climate of the Earth. (1 × 12 = 12) END OF THE QUESTION PAPER ***
questions.solution_html:
• Earth is a terrestrial planet / or an introduction (1 mark). Size- 5th largest planet, equatorial
  • radius is 6,378.14 km, polar radius is 6,356.75 km (2 marks). Shape - 1 mark - Oblate spheroid/
  • Geoid. Volume -1 mark - 260 billion cubic miles. Density - 1 mark - 5.5gm/cm3. Rotation -
  • Definition-1 mark- The Earth's spinning moti on on its axis, which takes 24 hours. Revolution -
  • Definition- 1 mark- The Earth's motion around the Sun in an elliptical path, which takes 365 days
  • and 6 hours.
  • Earth's rotation and revolution significantly influence its climate. The rotation of the Earth on its
  • axis causes the cycle of day and night, with the side facing the sun experiencing day (and warmth)
  • and the side away from the sun experiencing night (and cooler temperatures). The revolution of
  • the Earth around the sun, combined with the tilt of the Earth's axis, causes the changing seasons.
  • When the Earth's axis tilts towards the sun, it is summer for that hemisphere because the sun's rays
  • hit the Earth at a more direct angle, causing warmer temperatures. When the axis tilts away from
  • the sun, it is winter for that hemisphere because the sun's rays hit the Earth at a less direct angle,
  • causing cooler temperatures (4 mark).

questions.question: Describe metamorphism, and how does it differ from igneous and sedimentary processes. / [CO3] [1X12=12]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe metamorphism and how it differs from igneous and sedimentary processes. (12
  • marks)
  • Metamorphism:
  • • Process that alters the mineral composition and texture of rocks due to heat, pressure, and
  • chemically active fluids, without melting. 3 marks
  • Differences:
  • • Metamorphic vs Igneous:
  • o Igneous rocks form from complete melting and solidification, while metamorphism
  • occurs in the solid state. 3 marks
  • • Metamorphic vs Sedimentary:
  • o Sedimentary processes involve weathering, erosion, deposition, and lithification,
  • while metamorphism alters pre-existing rocks through heat and pressure. 3 marks
  • • Textures:
  • o Metamorphic rocks show foliated structures (e.g., schist, gneiss) unlike sedimentary
  • bedding or igneous crystalline textures. 3 marks
